name: read
description: Read a file from the local filesystem. Returns the file content as text. Supports reading a specific range of lines via the offset and limit parameters. Only works for text-based files (plain text, Markdown, source code, JSON, etc.).

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to read.

offset.description: The line number to start reading from (0-indexed). Omit to start from the beginning.

limit.description: The maximum number of lines to read. Omit to read the entire file (or remaining lines from offset).
